<plan>1. Place Table at the grass tile in front of the player to obtain the “Place Table” achievement.  
2. Move onto the newly placed table.  
3. Make Wood Pickaxe (requires wood in inventory and the table).  
4. Search for a stone tile: move 3 steps Southwest, Do on the stone to collect stone (Collect Stone).  
5. Still on the stone tile, Place Stone in front (Place Stone).  
6. Move 3 steps South, Do on coal tile to collect coal (Collect Coal).  
7. Find and do on an iron tile (Collect Iron).  
8. Return to the table tile, Place Furnace on it (Place Furnace).  
9. Make Iron Pickaxe and Iron Sword using the furnace, wood, coal, iron (Make Iron Pickaxe, Make Iron Sword).  
10. Move to a grass tile adjacent to the table, Place Plant (Place Plant).  
11. Do on the plant to eat it (Eat Plant).  
12. Locate and do on a zombie tile to defeat it (Defeat Zombie).  
13. Locate and do on a skeleton tile to defeat it (Defeat Skeleton).  
14. Locate and do on a cow tile to eat it (Eat Cow).  
15. Search for and do on a lake tile to drink water (Collect Drink).  
16. Search for and do on a sampling tile (Collect Sampling).  
17. Search for and do on a diamond tile (Collect Diamond).  
18. When energy drops below maximum, Sleep to restore energy (Wake Up).  
This plan covers all 22 achievements and will bring the player to completion.^/plan
